preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**9 for N in N_list)
preconditions.description: For every test case, N is an integer between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.
The number of N values provided matches T.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_lines[i]) == max_xor_sum(N_list[i]) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: For each test case i, the i-th output line is the maximum possible value of sum_{k=1}^{N} (k XOR P_k) over all permutations P of 1..N.
